ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 15% off the first order, yet 0 ads mention it, leaving a new buyer no reason to act. Put the 15% first order offer in the opening line of three new ads and repeat it on the creative.

None of your 7 ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, such as orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

All 7 of your ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so the feed shows products but gives no reason to stop. Add three story ads, one about how the drink is made, one hosting scene, and one customer moment.

5 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage rather than the product on screen, so a buyer who clicks a specific cocktail has to search for it again. Point each of those 5 ads to the product it shows.

ads_1: Story video ads opening on the 15% first order offer and a real pour
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, your only linked channel
